content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Courtside Buzz's PostCourtside BuzzApril 15 at 5:49 AM · Shared with PublicTIAGO SPLITTER EARNED HIS RESPECT! One game into the 2025-26 NBA season, the Portland Trail Blazers relieved head coach Chauncey Billups of his head coaching duties after allegedly being involved in a betting scandal. Assistant coach & 1x NBA champion (2014) as a player Tiago Splitter took over WITH NO NOTICE, led them to a 42-39 record in 81 games coached, & the playoffs. Splitter coached Portland to a gutsy play-in WIN over Phoenix on Tuesday, 114-110, securing the No. 7 seed, & they will face San Antonio in the first round. Respect to Tiago!
